preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

preconditions.expression: hex_string.startswith('#') and len(hex_string) == 7 and all(c in '0123456789abcdefABCDEF' for c in hex_string[1:])
preconditions.description: The string must start with '#' and be followed by exactly 6 hexadecimal characters (case-insensitive).

postconditions.description: The return value must be a dictionary with exactly the keys 'r', 'g', and 'b'.
Each component value must be an integer between 0 and 255 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value['r'] == int(hex_string[1:3], 16) and return_value['g'] == int(hex_string[3:5], 16) and return_value['b'] == int(hex_string[5:7], 16)
postconditions.description: The 'r', 'g', and 'b' values must correspond to the decimal conversion of the respective 2-character hexadecimal substrings from the input.
